A MIDI clip recorded from a controller keeps its CCs as MIDI Ctrl clip envelopes (Using MIDI CC in Live). Live sends its own bank and sub-bank changes as CC 0 and CC 32, so those two controllers are missing from the MIDI Ctrl chooser (Sending Program Change messages from Ableton Live). A recorded bank press would have no envelope to show it.

Ableton documents Program Change only as a clip setting sent at launch (Ableton/Live/UG/08 Clip View/03 Extended Clip Properties/02 MIDI Clip Bank and Program Change Controls). Chapter 19 of the Live 12 manual and those help articles say nothing about recording an incoming Program Change. A December 2024 forum thread asks whether Program Changes pass through unrecorded and doesn't settle it.

On that evidence, pad presses would change the MicroFreak's preset and leave nothing readable in the Set. Step 2 of #501 Record which MicroFreak preset is playing in GitP Sets, from Launchpad Custom Modes probably needs the Session-clip alternative under Routing and recording. Recording a clip on LPP CM2 to MF while pressing pads would show whether Live keeps anything.

Do Launchpad Custom Modes have pagination for selecting more Microfreak presets?

Short answer: No. Each Custom Mode is a single 8 × 8 page, and Novation documents no button that pages through a Custom Mode or adds a ninth one. Pads alone also fall short of 448 presets: a Program Change pad sends one program number from 0 to 127 and no bank, so 448 program pads reach at most 128 presets. Four bank select pads and 128 program pads, spread over three Custom Modes, reach all 512 MicroFreak slots, with a slot in another bank taking two presses.
